verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source crawling library with a CLI and Docker server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any telemetry, usage tracking, or a switch to disable it. The 'no forced API keys' claim and the self-hosted monitoring dashboard are adjacent features, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
